mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO investment_product_catalog ( product_type, product_code, isin_code, product_name, provider_name, category, source_type, active, last_synced_at ) VALUES ( #{productType}, #{productCode}, #{isinCode}, #{productName}, #{providerName}, #{category}, #{sourceType}, #{active}, #{lastSyncedAt} ) AS incoming
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE investment_product_id = LAST_INSERT_ID(investment_product_catalog.investment_product_id), isin_code = incoming.isin_code, product_name = incoming.product_name, provider_name = incoming.provider_name, category = incoming.category, source_type = incoming.source_type, active = incoming.active, last_synced_at = incoming.last_synced_at

INSERT INTO fund_product_detail ( investment_product_id, disclosure_base_date, return_1_month, return_3_months, return_6_months, return_12_months, fund_grade, upfront_fee_rate, total_expense_rate ) VALUES ( #{investmentProductId}, #{disclosureBaseDate}, #{return1Month}, #{return3Months}, #{return6Months}, #{return12Months}, #{fundGrade}, #{upfrontFeeRate}, #{totalExpenseRate} ) AS incoming
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE return_1_month = incoming.return_1_month, return_3_months = incoming.return_3_months, return_6_months = incoming.return_6_months, return_12_months = incoming.return_12_months, fund_grade = incoming.fund_grade, upfront_fee_rate = incoming.upfront_fee_rate, total_expense_rate = incoming.total_expense_rate
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM investment_product_catalog WHERE product_type = 'FUND' AND active = 1

SELECT c.investment_product_id AS investmentProductId, c.product_type AS productType, c.product_code AS productCode, c.isin_code AS isinCode, c.product_name AS productName, c.provider_name AS providerName, c.category AS category, c.source_type AS sourceType, c.active AS active, c.last_synced_at AS lastSyncedAt,
d.disclosure_base_date AS disclosureBaseDate, d.return_1_month AS return1Month, d.return_3_months AS return3Months, d.return_6_months AS return6Months, d.return_12_months AS return12Months, d.fund_grade AS fundGrade, d.upfront_fee_rate AS upfrontFeeRate, d.total_expense_rate AS totalExpenseRate
FROM investment_product_catalog c JOIN fund_product_detail d ON d.investment_product_id = c.investment_product_id WHERE c.product_type = 'FUND' AND c.active = 1 ORDER BY c.investment_product_id ASC
